_comment: Geometry regression scenarios. Adding a test is a JSON entry, not new code.
Model defaults these coordinates assume: Box 100 x 75 x 50, Wall_Thickness 1.85,
Post_Diameter 15, side openings 10 wide x 30 tall whose bottom edge sits
All_Openings_Up=5 above the box floor, so an opening spans z 5 to 35.
Front wall band spans y -37.5 (outer) to -35.65 (inner), so probes at y -37.3
with depth 1.4 sit strictly inside the wall and cannot pick up interior floor.
Probes are 1 mm wide on x so they stay inside the opening's rounded ends;
a wider probe clips the corner arc and reads material as a false negative.
solids counts disconnected bodies. Any unexpected increase means geometry has
detached, which looks normal in a render and fails in a slicer.

scenarios.name: regression_openings_full_height
scenarios._why: v1.1.0: the cut was centred on the box floor, so only its top half
scenarios._why2: intersected the model and a requested 30 mm opening delivered 15 mm.
scenarios._why3: z=20 is the discriminator: material under the bug, empty when fixed.

probes.why: front wall mid-opening
front wall at z=20, halved-opening detector
front wall above the opening
below a lifted opening
inside a lifted opening
above a lifted opening

scenarios.name: regression_bottom_count_zero_blocked
scenarios._why: v1.1.0: [0:-1] iterated as -1 then 0 under OpenSCAD's deprecated
scenarios._why2: reverse-range rule, cutting two openings that detached the post.

scenarios.name: regression_corner_radius_above_old_ceiling
scenarios._why: v1.1.0: clamp was derived from the outer shell but reused for the
scenarios._why2: inner cavity, so anything above 35.65 aborted inside BOSL2.

scenarios.name: regression_closed_post_caps_bottom
scenarios._why: v1.1.0: Closed_Post shortened the bore from the top, capping the
scenarios._why2: post's upper end and leaving the floor open.

probes.why: post floor must be solid when Closed_Post
post top must stay open
open post must bore through the floor
open post must be open at the top

scenarios.name: regression_clip_one_bonds_to_material
scenarios._why: v1.1.0: at Clips_Per_Edge=1 the clip landed over the open post bore
scenarios._why2: with nothing to bond to and exported as a third, loose solid.

expect.message: Slice piece to render must be an integer
Slice piece to render must be an integer

probes.why: front wall must be solid when openings are off

scenarios.name: gridfinity_bottom
scenarios._why: Base is ADDED below the box and the box is lifted, so the model
scenarios._why2: still sits on z=0. Cells land at x=+/-21 on the default footprint.
scenarios._why3: Base occupies z 0..4.75; mating cavity is cut z 0..4.3.

probes.why: mating cavity at cell centre
upper mating cavity at cell centre
solid base stock above the cavity
box floor sits on top of the base
box interior still hollow

scenarios.name: gridfinity_lid_top
scenarios._why: The lid's lip is its mating face, so z=0 is the exposed top and
scenarios._why2: the plate grows downward from there, with the lid lifted 4.75.
scenarios._why3: It is a baseplate with sockets, not studs: the lid inverts in
scenarios._why4: use, so studs would point at the ceiling and hold nothing.

probes.why: open socket, so a Gridfinity foot can drop into it
the slab between sockets is solid; studs left a gap here
socket floor: plate is 4.75 deep and the cavity stops at 4.3
lid panel above the plate
lip ring is perimeter only, so centre is open

scenarios.name: gridfinity_lid_top_magnets
scenarios._why: Pockets open at the socket floor (world z=4.30) and reach into
scenarios._why2: the lid panel, so a 2.4mm magnet sits flush with the floor.
scenarios._why3: The stud-era cut started at the panel interface and overlapped
scenarios._why4: the socket void, leaving a 0.45mm pocket a magnet stood proud
scenarios._why5: of. Default 100x75 box: lid cells at x=+-21, holes at +-13.

probes.why: pocket void above the socket floor, inside the panel
panel solid again above the 2.4mm pocket depth

scenarios.name: gridfinity_lid_sliced_thin
scenarios._why: Lid_Height=4.6 is legal and sits below the 4.75 plate. Cutters
scenarios._why2: sized from Lid_Height alone stopped short of the plate, leaving
scenarios._why3: a 0.15mm full-width layer welded to every slice: piece 1
scenarios._why4: measured 103.8mm wide instead of ~52 and defeated slicing.
scenarios._why5: x-max 29.96 is the slice plus its clip tabs; the broken
scenarios._why7: The probes below double as the regression for the sliver
scenarios._why8: degeneracy: the lid clip used to sit flush with the top of the
scenarios._why9: lid panel, which merged two coplanar faces on the seam and made
scenarios._why10: OpenSCAD tessellate four zero-area triangles into every sliced
scenarios._why11: lid piece. CGAL asserted on those, and probe() raises on that,
scenarios._why12: so any probe here fails if the flush placement comes back.
scenarios._why13: rc.5 lid footprint is Box + 2*(Wall_Thickness + Lid_Lip_Gap), 104 mm
scenarios._why14: here, so the seam moved from 25.95 to 26.0 and x-max from 29.91.

probes.why: clip tab, past the seam at x=26.0 and mid its 6.31-9.31 height
above the tab: it must stop below the 9.35 panel top, not at it
lid panel above the Gridfinity plate
past x-max, so the tab has a finite reach

scenarios.name: gridfinity_too_small_box_not_floating
scenarios._why: No 42mm cell fits, so the base is omitted. The lift must be
scenarios._why2: suppressed too, otherwise the box hangs 4.75mm above z=0.

probes.why: box wall must still start at z=0, not float above it

scenarios.name: snapclip_box_two_slices
scenarios._why: rabbit_clip cantilever seam joints. Solid count is the guard: a
scenarios._why2: clip oriented the wrong way, or one that bridges the preview gap,
scenarios._why3: both show up here and nowhere else.

scenarios.name: snapclip_lid_two_slices
scenarios._why: At the default 5mm preview spacing an 8mm pin used to reach the
scenarios._why2: next piece and fuse the preview into one body.

scenarios.name: snapclip_single_piece_export
scenarios._why: The case that actually gets printed: one piece, one solid, with
scenarios._why2: its pin attached rather than floating.
scenarios._why3: The bbox pins the clip's ORIENTATION, which solid counts cannot.
scenarios._why4: rabbit_clip builds length on Z, width on X, depth on Y, so it needs
scenarios._why5: orient=RIGHT AND spin=90. With orient alone, width (10) lands on Z
scenarios._why6: instead of depth (3), and z-min drops from 0 to about -3.5
scenarios._why7: while the model still renders and still counts as one solid.
scenarios._why8: z-min is 0 since rc.5 (F-51, floor clips below the bed): the clip
scenarios._why9: was centred on the floor and hung 0.575 mm below it, so a slicer
scenarios._why10: stood the whole piece on its clips. It now starts at the floor's
scenarios._why11: bottom face. rc.4 coupons printed with only the clip tabs on the bed.

scenarios.name: tabclip_single_piece_export
scenarios._why: Same measurement for the Tab style, so a change to shared clip
scenarios._why2: placement cannot silently move one style and not the other.
scenarios._why3: The probe proves the F-51 fix kept the full 3 mm clip and raised it
scenarios._why4: rather than shortening it: the tab spans z 0 to 3 at y 25.65-35.65,
scenarios._why5: and the rc.4 tab stopped at 2.425.

probes.why: top of the tab clip, above the 1.85 mm floor

scenarios.name: snapclip_short_length_blocked
scenarios._why: rabbit_clip aborts with 'Pin is too wide for its length', naming
scenarios._why2: neither parameter. The floor is exactly Clip_Tab_Width/2, measured
scenarios._why3: against BOSL2 2.0.747. Fail with something actionable instead.

expect.message: Clip_Snap_Length must exceed half of Clip_Tab_Width
Clip_Style must be Tab or Snap

scenarios.name: anchor_lid_face_is_the_exposed_side
scenarios._why: The v1.2.0 Gridfinity bug encoded as a regression test. The lid
scenarios._why2: prints face-down, so the face exposed when the box is closed is
scenarios._why3: the model's z=0 face. v1.2.0 placed the interface at Lid_Height +
scenarios._why4: Lid_Lip_Gap_Height, the MATING face, burying it in the closed box.
scenarios._why5: A 6mm marker attached to lid-face must reach BELOW z=0 (to -3).
scenarios._why6: On the wrong face it would sit up around z=+14 instead.

scenarios.name: anchor_box_floor
scenarios._why: The floor anchor sits on the interior floor surface at z=1.85
scenarios._why2: (Wall_Thickness), not on the outer bottom at z=0.

scenarios.name: anchor_box_rim
scenarios._why: The rim anchor sits on top of the wall at Box_Height.

scenarios.name: library_mode_renders_nothing
scenarios._why: Render_On_Include=false must suppress the auto-render so the file
scenarios._why2: can be included as a library. OpenSCAD exits 1 when asked to
scenarios._why3: export an empty scene, so a non-zero exit IS the proof here.

scenarios.name: missing_bosl2_fails_legibly
scenarios._why: Without a guard, a missing BOSL2 gives 'Can't open include file'
scenarios._why2: then a wall of 'Ignoring unknown module' warnings, no geometry,
scenarios._why3: and exit code 0. The zero exit makes it look like it worked.
scenarios._why4: Fixture is the model with its include redirected to a library that
scenarios._why5: does not exist; regenerate with scripts/regen_missing_bosl2_fixture.py.

scenarios.name: library_mode_off_still_renders
scenarios._why: Guards the other direction: the default must still auto-render,
scenarios._why2: or opening the file in OpenSCAD would show nothing.

scenarios.name: e04_edge_treatment_box
scenarios._why: Fillet and chamfer route the outer shell through offset_sweep
scenarios._why2: instead of cuboid. The envelope must not move: both treatments
scenarios._why3: cut inward from edges the full-size footprint still reaches.

scenarios.name: e04_edge_treatment_suppressed_by_gridfinity
scenarios._why: The Gridfinity base is dimensioned by the standard, so a fillet
scenarios._why2: on the box bottom would move a mating surface. Suppression is
scenarios._why3: gated on GF_Bottom_Active, not the Enable_ parameter, so a box
scenarios._why4: too small for a cell keeps its fillet.

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_scallop
scenarios._why: A scallop cuts a half-cylinder groove into the lid's outer face,
scenarios._why2: so it removes material without moving the envelope.
scenarios._why3: rc.5 lid footprint is Box + 2*(Wall_Thickness + Lid_Lip_Gap):
scenarios._why4: 104 x 79 on the default box, up from 103.8 x 78.8.

probes.why: inside the groove at mid lid height
same height, past the end of a 20mm groove

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_tab
scenarios._why: A tab adds material, so unlike the scallop it does move the
scenarios._why2: envelope: exactly Lid_Relief_Depth on the two enabled sides.
scenarios._why3: rc.5 lid footprint: 52.0 + 2.5 per side, up from 51.9 + 2.5.

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_skipped_by_full_height_opening
scenarios._why: Relief lives in the lid and openings in the box, so they only
scenarios._why2: meet when an opening runs to the rim. Then the relief is dropped:
scenarios._why3: a Tab would otherwise stand over a hole. The envelope proves it,
scenarios._why4: because a placed tab would push x to 54.5 (rc.5 lid footprint).

scenarios.name: e04_lid_magnets_box
scenarios._why: Bosses run the full box height so they print off the bed rather
scenarios._why2: than hanging from the rim. The pocket opens at the rim and stops
scenarios._why3: Lid_Magnet_Depth down, leaving the boss solid below it.

probes.why: boss body, well below the pocket
inside the magnet pocket, which opens at z=47.6
boss reaches the floor, so nothing overhangs

scenarios.name: e04_lid_magnets_lid
scenarios._why: The lid pocket opens on the face that meets the box rim and
scenarios._why2: reaches down into the slab, so the exposed face stays solid and
scenarios._why3: the magnet is captured rather than visible.

probes.why: inside the lid pocket, which opens at z=5.7
slab below the pocket: the exposed face stays closed

scenarios.name: e04_lid_magnets_survive_slicing
scenarios._why: Corner bosses sit at extreme x and slice seams at interior x,
scenarios._why2: which is why corners were chosen over distributed placement.
scenarios._why3: This asserts they do not meet rather than assuming it.

scenarios.name: e04_lid_magnet_too_big_blocked
scenarios._why: A magnet larger than the cavity is a silent merge otherwise.

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_skipped_by_per_wall_lift
scenarios._why: The rim check once added only All_Openings_Up, so an opening raised
scenarios._why2: to the rim by Move_Opening_Right_Up still got a tab over it. Only
scenarios._why3: the right wall reaches the rim here, so the left tab must stay:
scenarios._why4: the envelope is asymmetric, 54.5 on the left and 52.0 on the right

scenarios.name: e04_opening_above_rim_reported
scenarios._why: An opening lifted past the rim is cut open to the top as a notch.
scenarios._why2: That is legal, so it is reported rather than rejected; before the
scenarios._why3: report it rendered with no message at all.

expect.output_contains: Front opening top edge at 65 mm is above Box_Height 50 mm

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_width_long_wall
scenarios._why: The width check once used the shorter of the two walls for every
scenarios._why2: relief. The left and right walls here are 150 mm, so a 100 mm
scenarios._why3: relief fits them even though the 60 mm front wall could not take it.
scenarios._why4: rc.5 lid footprint: 64 x 154, so x is 32.0 + 2.5 and y is 77.0.

scenarios.name: e04_lid_relief_width_short_wall_blocked
scenarios._why: The same box still rejects a relief too long for its short wall,
scenarios._why2: and the message names that wall.

expect.message: rounded corners alone on the Front wall

scenarios.name: validation_opening_height_ignored_when_walls_closed
scenarios._why: The opening-height bound once fired with every side opening off,
scenarios._why2: so a 12 mm box was rejected for a 30 mm opening it never cuts.

scenarios.name: assembly_skirt_lid_does_not_overlap_box
scenarios._why: From v1.0.0 to rc.4 the lid's lip ring spanned 48.25 to 50.10 mm on
scenarios._why2: a 50 mm box whose wall spans 46.30 to 50.00, so it landed on the
scenarios._why3: rim and the lid could not fit. Printed coupons stacked 19 mm, not 16.
scenarios._why4: Seated, a Skirt lid must overlap nothing, including the
scenarios._why5: post collar, whose bore once matched the post with zero clearance.
scenarios._why6: OpenSCAD exits 1 on an empty export, so rc 1 is the proof.

scenarios.name: assembly_plug_lid_does_not_overlap_box
scenarios._why: The Plug lip sits inside the wall, beside the stabilizer fins.

scenarios.name: assembly_plug_lid_clears_magnet_bosses
scenarios._why: The magnet bosses fill the box's inside corners to the rim, where
scenarios._why2: a Plug ring would run into them; the ring is notched around each.

scenarios.name: assembly_skirt_lid_engages_outside_wall
scenarios._why: An empty overlap would also pass for a lid hovering over the box,
scenarios._why2: so this proves the skirt hangs past the rim, outside the wall.
scenarios._why3: Skirt spans x 50.15 to 52.0 on the 100 mm default box.

probes.why: skirt beside the right wall, 2 mm below the rim

scenarios.name: assembly_plug_lid_engages_inside_wall
scenarios._why: The same proof for the Plug: its ring spans x 46.15 to 48.0, inside
scenarios._why2: the right wall's inner face at 48.15.
scenarios._why3: No Lid_Style define, deliberately: this pins Plug as the default,
scenarios._why4: which rc.5 test prints chose. A Skirt default leaves the probe empty.

probes.why: plug ring inside the right wall, 2 mm below the rim

scenarios.name: lid_plug_notched_for_magnets
scenarios._why: Lid on its own: the plug ring is present along the wall and cut
scenarios._why2: away around each magnet boss at (44.05, 31.55), radius 4.45.

probes.why: plug ring mid right wall
notch around the corner magnet boss

scenarios.name: lid_plug_survives_slicing
scenarios._why: Piece 1 of a two-slice Plug lid stays one solid and keeps its ring.
scenarios._why2: Ring on the left wall spans x -22.0 to -20.15 once the piece is
scenarios._why3: centred; the lid is laid out 95 mm along y.

probes.why: plug ring on the left wall of piece 1

expect.message: Lid_Style must be Skirt or Plug

scenarios.name: validation_plug_blocked_by_tall_stabilizers
scenarios._why: Fins reaching within Lid_Lip_Gap_Height of the rim would meet a
scenarios._why2: Plug. 1.85 + 37 = 38.85 passes the box's own check (<= 40) but not
scenarios._why3: the plug's (<= 37). The same box with Lid_Style Skirt renders.

scenarios.name: validation_plug_needs_room_inside_walls
scenarios._why: A 7.5 mm box leaves 3.8 mm inside its walls, too little for a
scenarios._why2: 1.85 mm plug ring with 0.15 mm clearance on each side.

expect.message: too small for a Plug lid

scenarios.name: validation_plug_blocked_by_wide_post
scenarios._why: A 33 mm post fits a 40 mm box's 36.3 mm interior, but its radius
scenarios._why2: plus clearance (16.65) passes the plug ring's inner face (16.15).

scenarios.name: assembly_box_slices_do_not_overlap
scenarios._why: E-13 (seam joints). Two box slices joined, SPACER apart along X so
scenarios._why2: the flat floor faces do not merely touch. A seam that fits leaves
scenarios._why3: the overlap empty. This passes against rc.5 too: it guards the fit,
scenarios._why4: and the lifted and dropped scenarios below prove the lock.

scenarios.name: assembly_box_slices_lock_when_lifted
scenarios._why: rc.5 prints: the halves slid vertically, because the floor clip's
scenarios._why2: socket runs through the floor. Raised 0.5 mm, more than the 0.2 mm
scenarios._why3: Clip_Tolerance, slice 2 must collide with slice 1. Against rc.5
scenarios._why4: the overlap is empty and OpenSCAD exits 1.

scenarios.name: assembly_box_slices_lock_when_dropped
scenarios._why: The same proof downward: one tooth face blocks each direction.
scenarios._why2: Both checks look above the floor clips, which a dropped slice
scenarios._why3: only touches, flush with the wall; CGAL reports that unreliably.

scenarios.name: assembly_lid_slices_do_not_overlap
scenarios._why: The lid's seam gets the same profile below its seam clips.

scenarios.name: assembly_lid_slices_lock_when_lifted
scenarios._why: At the default 8.1 mm lid the tooth band is z 0 to 4.9, room for
scenarios._why2: one 2.45 mm tooth, which locks both directions. The check looks
scenarios._why3: below the lid clips, whose slab-closed sockets already block
scenarios._why4: lifting with a flat seam, so only the tooth can make it collide.

scenarios.name: assembly_lid_slices_lock_when_dropped
scenarios._why: The direction the lid clips never held: their sockets open upward.

scenarios.name: seam_teeth_on_box_slice_1
scenarios._why: Piece 1's seam is at x=25 once exported. Above the default back
scenarios._why2: opening (z 5 to 35) the teeth start at z=35 and peak 3 mm past the
scenarios._why3: seam at z=38, less half of Clip_Tolerance: material to x=27.9.
scenarios._why4: Against rc.5 piece 1 stops at x=25.

probes.why: a tooth in the back wall, past the seam, at its peak

scenarios.name: seam_notches_on_box_slice_2
scenarios._why: Piece 2's seam is at x=-25 once exported, and its wall recedes to
scenarios._why2: x=-21.9 at z=38 to take piece 1's tooth. Against rc.5 it is solid.

probes.why: the notch in the back wall that piece 1's tooth fills
the back wall beyond the notch

scenarios.name: seam_three_slices_middle_piece_one_solid
scenarios._why: A middle piece carries the profile on both edges. Its notches and
scenarios._why2: teeth must not cut it apart, beside the default openings.

scenarios.name: seam_flat_when_tooth_depth_zero
scenarios._why: Seam_Tooth_Depth=0 takes the flat cutter path unchanged, so a
scenarios._why2: plain butt seam stays available. Same bbox as the tab-clip export.

probes.why: no tooth past the seam

scenarios.name: validation_seam_tooth_depth_too_deep
scenarios._why: A middle piece carries notches from both edges, so teeth deeper
scenarios._why2: than half a slice, less clearance, would cut through it.

scenarios.name: validation_lid_too_thin_for_seam_clips
scenarios._why: Backlog item 19 (lid seam clips below the bed). A lid seam clip
scenarios._why2: spans Lid_Height - Clip_Tab_Height to Lid_Height, so a 2.5 mm lid
scenarios._why3: hangs it 0.54 mm below the bed, the floor-clip fault rc.5 fixed.
